RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a deciding factor in your non-selection. An all-female panel appointing a qualified woman offers no evidence of unlawful sex discrimination or procedural irregularity. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation within the civil service.

Instead, focus on obtaining constructive feedback. A two-week wait is common for government HR processes. Follow up politely regarding your requested written feedback, asking specifically how you can strengthen your competencies—such as international project leadership—for future senior opportunities.
